title: The day after a miss: a harder kickoff, held to the full step
origin: Spec #6 (nudge scheduler), part 2: "Day after a miss"

history.text: Hey Sam! Ten pages of Dune on the couch at 7 tonight. Ready?

plan.proof_note: a quick voice note saying where you stopped
plan.reason: Ten pages a night builds the habit without eating your evening.

testerLines: ugh yeah yesterday got away from me
[voice: Ten pages of Dune done on the couch, I stopped right where Paul meets the Fremen] done, all 10 pages
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: the day after a miss. Since proof (#7), "done" without a photo isn't a check mark, so the done text now carries the proof (a voice note, which the coach can judge from its words).
shouldHaveHappened: A morning kickoff that names yesterday's slip without guilt (one miss is a slip, not two) and pushes a little harder than usual for the full ten pages of Dune at 7, with at most a smaller version as the fallback. The reply to "yesterday got away from me" accepts it once, warmly, and turns straight to tonight. A short check-in around 6:50. "done, all 10 pages" gets a real, specific celebration. Nothing after that.
